name: Nadia Brost

statedReqs.notes: Sold a duplex portfolio in March. 'Seven and a half or I keep looking, and I would rather not keep looking.'

hiddenPrefs.desc: The exchange clock is real — she pays tax on every dollar she does not place, which is why she sounds calm and is not.
Will not buy a slab with an untested environmental history. A Phase II takes six weeks and she does not have six weeks.

intro: Trades in and out of small industrial, never holds a management headache. Reads a rent roll the way other people read a menu.
